steps.caption: Open Transactions and the Lumen Harbour Tech transaction.
Closure blockers at the top counts what still stops completion.
Section 16, Closure pack. 'Completion blocked' lists every reason: open issues, pending approvals, unverified documents, unpaid deposits, handover not completed.
Mark transaction complete stays disabled until the list is empty.
Generate closure pack (.docx): terms, milestones, approvals, documents and open items, as they stand.
The pack appears as a link with its version and date. Generate again later for a new version — old ones are kept.
Execution milestones show the Lease Lifecycle hand-off once the executed agreement is recorded — the lease then appears under Leases.
The timeline at the bottom is append-only: every offer, change, approval and milestone with its time.
